evidence_basis: CloudShell analysis and validation outputs supplied by the operator; raw D calibration artifacts are not yet available in this checkout for independent verification.
selection_rule: Higher all-attempted-request TTFT <= 2 s attainment; within six SLO successes out of 300, prefer lower allocated GPU-hours, then lower successful-request TTFT p99, then lower threshold.
limits: One run per candidate; no optimality or statistical superiority claim.
All failed requests count against SLO; p99 uses successful requests only.
D0.2 stream failures are unconfirmed in cause; D0.1 error details and retained load-balancer log remain to be inspected.
Actual sample gaps are about 14 s at maximum, not an exact 5 s cadence.
D0.1 adds load-balancer log collection after measurement without changing policy or timeout.
D is a system reference with different routing, demand estimator and model cache lifecycle from B/C.
Workload rates and the measured 48-run matrix are not frozen by this selection.
